docs.title: Docs
docs.intro: This site is a multi-source directory for DeepSeek Harness plugins. The catalog is fetched, deduplicated and generated at build time; the pages themselves are static.
docs.installBody: Open Settings → Plugins in the DSH client and search for the package name, or run:
docs.indexBody: Add either URL under Settings → Plugins → Index sources. Use the GitCode source in mainland China and the GitHub source elsewhere.
docs.sourceBody: This site aggregates the following indexes. Deduplication is keyed by package name plus repository owner, so forks with the same package name are never merged.
